description: This is a Java source file defining a helper logging class 'Log' within the package 'com.example.android.common.logger'. It provides static methods to facilitate logging at different levels and manages a chain of LogNode objects to handle log output, acting as a replacement for Android's native android.util.Log.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods for logging at various levels, managing LogNode chains, and acting as a replacement for android.util.Log.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode chain used for log processing.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode which will handle the log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level.
